data.name: Diag.Checklist
data.value: 1. The overlay at the bottom of the screen does not take focus: type in Notepad — the caret stays in Notepad. 2. Click a keycap on the overlay — the click reaches the window below. 3. Press and release A — the keycap appears and fades after the linger time. 4. Hold A for 3 s — one pressed keycap without a badge; Repeats grows in the diagnostics. 5. Ctrl+Shift+K — “Ctrl Shift K” (L/R marks on top); release K and press it again while holding the modifiers — badge “2” on K. 6. Left and right Shift/Ctrl/Alt have different marks (L/R). Enter and Num Enter differ (the second has the Num mark). 7. Type a word quickly with overlapping keys — letters are not merged into a “combination”. 8. Alt+Tab to another window and back — the overlay is not in the Alt+Tab list or on the taskbar. 9. “Hide overlay” → wait 5 s → the overlay does not come back by itself; “Show overlay” brings it back. 10. Export JSON and open the file: only counters and percentiles, no labels or key codes. 11. (X8) Start with --ring=8: “Freeze UI for 3 s”; while frozen, type and release all keys. After it: drop epoch > 0, resync done, “down now” = 0, no stuck keys on the overlay. Look, layout, help: “Settings…” and “Help (F1)”; F1 works in this window, in settings and in help. For compare: the same steps; compare EventsTotal and Comparator by class. A difference is an observation, not a verdict.
